source.source_date: Not supplied for the campus feature; snapshot timestamp recorded separately.
source.reference_status: Official campus GIS polygon, FID 411 / BALY; not a certified survey. The feature reports NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5, which are source attributes, not measured height.

secondary_visual_references.use: Official BALY page identifies the building and provides an exterior photo. The photo supports red brick, limestone accents, a flat roof/parapet, entrance context, and two visible above-grade window rows. An 8 m shell height is only a visual estimate scaled approximately against a 2.4 m assumed entrance door; the photo is not an elevation or measured source.

transform.axes: X east, Y north, Z up
transform.units: meters; local project approximation, not surveyed CRS

measurements.method: Reprojected the 22 distinct vertices of official FID 411 using the documented approximate project-local conversion. The build script constructs the structural shell directly from that ring; entry and canopy details are excluded from structural plan comparison.
measurements.after_structural_shell: Built directly from all 22 distinct FID 411 source vertices. The photo-referenced entrance tower projects beyond the mapped wall boundary and is excluded from the structural footprint comparison.
measurements.position_status: Structural wall coordinates match the official GIS source transform; the service does not publish positional uncertainty, so absolute location accuracy is unverified.
measurements.plan_dimension_status: Structural shell uses the official source polygon; boundary is a campus map outline, not a surveyed wall footprint.
measurements.orientation_status: Structural shell follows source polygon order; independent true-north/entrance orientation review remains open.
measurements.height_status: The lower-wing parapet is modeled at an estimated 7.5 m from the exterior photos. The entrance tower apex is modeled at 10.18 m using GIS field R=33.4 tentatively interpreted as feet; the service metadata documents coordinate units as US survey feet but gives no field-level unit/meaning definition. These are estimates, not surveyed elevations. GIS NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 conflict with two visible above-grade facade rows; the floor-count conflict remains unresolved.

tentative_gis_vertical_fields.interpretation: F02 and R are field names suggestive of floor/roof elevations; their definitions and units are not documented. R=33.4 was tentatively interpreted as feet only to guide the estimated taller entrance tower, and is not treated as a verified height measurement.

measurements.facade_observation: Purdue's current exterior image shows two visible rows of windows, red brick, light limestone bands/trim, and a flat parapet roof. These visible details inform the model; photo perspective and partial tree obstruction limit exact facade reconstruction.

geometry_edits: Replaced the massing extrusion footprint with the official source polygon while preserving the asset object, collection, scene, ID and file path.
Added facade materials, repeated window bays, window surrounds, one intermediate limestone band, plinth and roof coping.

Revised the shell from an unsupported 16 m height and five evenly spaced facade rows to a 7.5 m photo-scaled lower-wing parapet with two photo-supported above-grade window rows; kept the GIS five-level attribute as an unresolved conflict.

Added a photo-referenced raised entrance/lobby tower that projects beyond the GIS wall boundary, with a tall glazed bay, side glazing, vertical sign panel and limestone cap; its height and dimensions remain estimates, with the 10.18 m apex tentatively guided by undocumented GIS field R=33.4.
Added an entrance marker oriented toward west; exact facade detail placement remains approximate.
uncertainties: The official campus GIS polygon is not a certified survey and publishes no positional or dimensional uncertainty.
The 7.5 m lower-wing parapet and 10.18 m entrance tower heights are estimates; no elevation, section, or surveyed height source was found. GIS F02/R units and field definitions are undocumented.
GIS NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 conflict with the two visible above-grade window rows in the official exterior photo; the actual level accounting is unresolved.
Entrance location and tower dimensions remain approximate; the oblique photos do not establish geographic orientation or all facade bays.

The initial revisions scored 6.75/10, 7.5/10, and 7.75/10. The current projecting tower revision received an independent grade of 8/10; the complete criterion-level result is saved in independent_grade_final.json. Remaining uncertainties are retained above.
